title: Understanding LASSO Regularization
text: LASSO regularization adds a penalty equal to the absolute value of the magnitude of coefficients to the loss function. This can lead to some coefficients being exactly zero, effectively selecting a simpler model.

title: Effect on Model Complexity
text: Using LASSO regularization can reduce model complexity by shrinking some coefficients to zero. How might this affect the model's performance on unseen data?

title: Bias-Variance Tradeoff
text: Consider how LASSO affects the bias-variance tradeoff. Increasing regularization can increase bias but decrease variance. How does this tradeoff impact MSE on held-out test data?

title: Analyzing MSE on Test Data
text: When using LASSO regularization, how does the change in model complexity affect the MSE on held-out test data?
